fn magnitude(value: i32) -> i32 { if value < 0 { 0 - value } else { value } }
fn main() { let amount = magnitude(-17); let result: u64 = (amount + 25i32) as u64; println!("{result}"); }
fn main() { let mut total: u64 = 0; for value in 0..8 { if value == 3 { continue; } if value == 6 { break; } total = total + value; } println!("{total}"); }

fn pair() -> (u64, u64) { (19, 23) }
fn main() { let values = pair(); let result = values.0 + values.1; println!("{result}"); }

fn sum(values: &[u64]) -> u64 { let mut total: u64 = 0; for value in values { total = total + *value; } total }
fn main() { let values: [u64; 3] = [7, 11, 24]; let result = sum(&values); println!("{result}"); }

fn check(value: u64) -> Result<(), &'static str> { if value == 42 { Ok(()) } else { Err("wrong") } }
fn main() { let result = check(42); let answer = if result.is_ok() { 42u64 } else { 0u64 }; println!("{answer}"); }
